messages:
ada: Vendor Heliodor reported an unexpected July spike — they say a data migration hit production keys. Asking for a refund + note to prevent auto-pause.

tom: Drop invoice id and a few usage lines so I can see magnitude. We have an auto-credit cap of $7.5k; anything above needs manager OK.

ada: INV-2025-3210. Snippet:
```
2025-07-12,api-gen,1,24000
2025-07-13,api-gen,1,8000
2025-07-14,matrix-embed,1,1200
```
Total billed $51k after retainer. They ask for ~$30k back.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-3210 found. Outstanding balance: $51,000. Auto-credit threshold: $7,500.

regina: Ops view: we can prorate retainer for the migration hours (~$9k) and offer max goodwill of $7.5k per policy for first-time migration mistakes. That totals $16.5k. Recommend requiring an attestation + mitigation plan before applying.

claire: I'm ok to approve $16,500. Use GL 5407 and memo "heliodor-migrate-refund-jul25". I'll sign off.

tom: Creating credit memo CM-2025-1182 for $16,500 and applying to INV-2025-3210. Will upload audit entry.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2025-1182 created for $16,500 and applied to INV-2025-3210. Audit note: "approved by claire 1777777850".

ada: Thanks — sending vendor the credit confirmation and requesting mitigation attestation. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
